table.title: Colony Table Panel
table.about: Glass panel behind the header band and the ten colony rows.

list_area.title: Colony List Area
list_area.about: Area holding the column headings and the colony rows; also where the stranded-pop notice strip is drawn.

planet_info.title: Planet Info Window
planet_info.about: Lower-left window of the scanned colony; holds the disc, name and paragraph, and shows a refused move's sentence.

colony_panel.title: Colony Panel
colony_panel.about: Lower-middle window that contains the output rows, the surface picture and the empire readouts.

galaxy_inset.title: Galaxy Inset
galaxy_inset.about: Lower-right window with the small galaxy map and the scanned star's name below it.

sort_name.title: Sort by Name
sort_name.about: Toggle button that sorts the colony list by name (hotkey n).

sort_population.title: Sort by Population
sort_population.about: Toggle button that sorts the colony list by population (hotkey p).

sort_food.title: Sort by Food
sort_food.about: Toggle button that sorts the colony list by food (hotkey f).

sort_industry.title: Sort by Industry
sort_industry.about: Toggle button that sorts the colony list by industry (hotkey i).

sort_science.title: Sort by Science
sort_science.about: Toggle button that sorts the colony list by science (hotkey s).

sort_producing.title: Sort by Producing
sort_producing.about: Toggle button that sorts the colony list by what each colony is producing (hotkey r).

sort_bc.title: Sort by BC
sort_bc.about: Toggle button that sorts the colony list by bc income (hotkey b).

return.title: Return Button
return.about: Button that leaves the Colonies screen; its label comes from the screen's layout data.

header.title: Column Header Band
header.about: Band across the top of the list that carries the column heading plates.

planet_disc.title: Planet Disc
planet_disc.about: Picture of the scanned colony's planet, chosen by its climate.

planet_name.title: Planet Name
planet_name.about: The scanned colony's name as a heading above the paragraph.

planet_paragraph.title: Planet Paragraph
planet_paragraph.about: Descriptive text paragraph for the scanned colony.

planet_output.title: Colony Output Rows
planet_output.about: Rows of the scanned colony's outputs (food, industry, research and so on) with label left and value right.

planet_surface.title: Planet Surface Picture
planet_surface.about: Landscape picture for the scanned colony's climate, with soft faded left and right edges.

empire_stats.title: Empire Statistics
empire_stats.about: Six empire readouts: Reserve, Income, Population, Freighters, Food and Research.

col_name.title: Name Column
col_name.about: Column for colony names: its heading plate, cells and click target.

col_farmers.title: Farmers Column
col_farmers.about: Column showing each colony's farmers: its heading plate, cells and drop target for moving pops.

col_workers.title: Workers Column
col_workers.about: Column showing each colony's workers: its heading plate, cells and drop target for moving pops.

col_scientists.title: Scientists Column
col_scientists.about: Column showing each colony's scientists: its heading plate, cells and drop target for moving pops.

col_building.title: Building Column
col_building.about: Column showing what each colony is building, with the buy control.

col_scroll.title: Scroll Column
col_scroll.about: Column at the list's right edge for the scroll bar.

help_popup.title: Help Panel
help_popup.about: Hidden box; the right-click help text panel appears here, and only while help is shown.
